purpose: Prototype still renders: a lean shot-environment level composed from a curated subset of the Brutalist kit, plus one camera per environment shot. Stills only; camera moves and video are a later tier.
composition_note: The 25-piece kit is a REVIEW GRID of comparison variants, not a scene (see Saved/Audit/brutalist_stage_manifest.json and Python/stage_brutalist_layout.py). This file selects 8 pieces and places them as a depth-layered vista. Positions below are UE world centimetres, deliberately NOT the manifest's review positions: the Blender->UE axis mapping (x*100, -y*100, z*100) exists to REPRODUCE reviewed positions, and applying it to hand-composed coordinates would double-negate. Render-frame and focal data still come from the shot manifest.

render_tier.name: prototype
render_tier.why: Docs/FILM_PIPELINE.md section 9 specifies the FINAL tier (16-bit EXR, '256+ samples'). That is a 1-2 week render per the same document's budget. This machine is a GTX 1050 Ti (4 GB) with a 4-thread i5-7300HQ, so prototyping uses the cheapest settings that still show banding, sky and composition errors.
render_tier.method_note: Chosen over MovieRenderPipeline because MRQ derives its frame range from the LevelSequence playback range, and the shipped LS_SH* sequences are 72-96 frames long -- a still would mean mutating a shared sequence. take_high_res_screenshot renders exactly one frame from a specific camera actor with no sequence involvement. MRQ remains the documented path for the video tier.
render_tier.filmback_note: 35 x 19.6875 mm is exactly 1.77778 (16:9), i.e. this resolution's aspect. It is NOT optional: take_high_res_screenshot constrains the captured frame to the CAMERA's filmback aspect, so an inherited 35 x 24.89 Academy back (1.40618:1) returned 1012 x 720 for a 1280 x 720 request -- measured 2026-10-01, engine log 'Tracing Screenshot "COMP_SH010_proto_v01" taken with size: 1012 x 720'. Derive the back from the resolution above; never hardcode a film default.
render_tier.output_note: .gitignore excludes /Saved/* except Audit/Reports json|md|txt, and states 'a PNG on its own is not evidence'. Prototype stills are therefore regenerable local output and are NOT versioned; the JSON report IS. Docs/GROUP_STAGING_GUIDE.md reserves 04_Renders/ + LFS for hero/final frames.

level.name: L_Toon_Shot_Env
level.why_separate: L_Brutalist_Layout stays the untouched review grid. L_Toon_Lookdev carries Landscape + 64 LandscapeStreamingProxy + 64 WorldPartitionHLOD + VolumetricCloud (measured via project_query get_stats); that is not a 4 GB budget to prototype in.

ground.note: Grounds the masses and catches the key-light shadow terminator, which is what makes toon banding readable.

deferred.camera_moves: Spec carries per-shot framing only. Move curves belong in Python/build_shot_deck.py (the owner of LS_SH*), added when the video tier starts -- a still cannot validate a move, so building it now would be unverifiable work.
deferred.outlines: No mesh has an outline material assigned (all 25 meshes carry MI_Toon_Environment in both slots, measured). Docs/FILM_PIPELINE.md section 8 prescribes the inverted-hull approach; the hull needs DUPLICATED actors with MI_Outline_Heavy (not a second material slot, which maps to a face group) and doubles draw calls. Gate it on the first still's read.
deferred.character_shots: SH040/SH050/SH060/SH080 are character framings (waist-up, macro face, hero performance, bow). They are excluded from this environment pass on purpose -- no character is staged yet.
